note: Controls written by this project. A control applies when at least one of its criteria's categories is in scope and every `when` condition matches the scoping answers.

controls.title: Security program ownership
controls.description: A named person owns the security program. Roles, reporting lines and the authority to make security decisions are written down and reviewed each year.
evidence: Current record of security roles and who holds them

controls.title: Code of conduct
controls.description: Personnel acknowledge the code of conduct when they join and each year after. Violations are handled under a documented process.
evidence: Acknowledgment for each person in the period

controls.title: Management oversight review
controls.description: Management, and someone independent of day-to-day operation where the organization is small, reviews the security program, open risks, deficiencies and exceptions at least once a year and records the outcome.
evidence: Dated record of the review, attendees and decisions

controls.title: Approved security policies
controls.description: Security policies are approved by management, versioned, available to personnel, and reviewed at least once a year.
evidence: Approval record for each policy version in force

controls.title: Policy acknowledgment
controls.description: Personnel acknowledge the security policies when they join and whenever a policy changes materially.
evidence: Acknowledgment for each person and policy version

controls.title: Reporting channel for security concerns
controls.description: Personnel know how to report a security concern or incident, and the channel is described in the onboarding material.
evidence: Onboarding material naming the reporting channel

controls.title: Commitments communicated to customers
controls.description: Service commitments, security responsibilities and a security contact are published to customers, and changes are communicated.
evidence: Published terms, SLA or security page and its revision history

controls.title: System description maintained
controls.description: A description of the services, commitments, system components, people and data is kept current and reviewed each year.
evidence: Current system description with its review date

controls.title: Annual risk assessment
controls.description: At least once a year the organization identifies risks to its objectives, including fraud and significant changes, rates likelihood and impact, and records them in the risk register.
evidence: Risk register as reviewed, with the review date and reviewer

controls.title: Risk treatment tracked
controls.description: Every risk above tolerance has a treatment decision, an owner and a due date, and progress is reviewed.
evidence: Risk register entries with treatment, owner and status

controls.title: Control operation reviewed
controls.description: The operation of controls is reviewed at least quarterly. Deficiencies are recorded with an owner and tracked to closure.
evidence: Quarterly review record and the deficiency list

controls.title: Independent penetration test
controls.description: An independent party tests the system at least once a year. Findings are rated and remediated on the schedule the policy sets.
evidence: Penetration test report
Remediation record for each finding

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning and remediation
controls.description: Systems and dependencies are scanned for known vulnerabilities, and findings are fixed within the time the policy sets for their severity.
evidence: Scan results
Remediation within the policy's deadlines

controls.title: Internal audit of the program
controls.description: At least once a year someone independent of the work being checked audits the program against its policies and the frameworks it follows, and management receives the findings.
evidence: Internal audit plan, report and management's response

controls.title: Background checks
controls.description: Personnel with access to the system pass a background check before access is granted, as the personnel policy requires.
evidence: Check completion for each new person

controls.title: Security awareness training
controls.description: Personnel complete security awareness training, with a knowledge check, when they join and each year after.
evidence: Training and quiz result for each person in the period

controls.title: Onboarding with approved access
controls.description: Each new person follows an onboarding checklist, and the access they receive is approved for their role.
evidence: Completed onboarding checklist and access approval for each new person

controls.title: Timely offboarding
controls.description: When someone leaves, their access to every in-scope system is removed within the time the policy sets.
evidence: Removal record for each leaver with dates

controls.title: Confidentiality agreements
controls.description: Personnel and contractors sign a confidentiality agreement before they receive access to confidential information.
evidence: Signed agreement for each person

controls.title: Defined responsibilities
controls.description: Each role with security responsibilities has them written down, and the people holding those roles are competent for them.
evidence: Role descriptions with security responsibilities

controls.title: Unique accounts with strong authentication
controls.description: Every person uses their own account on in-scope systems, and multi-factor authentication is required where the system supports it.
evidence: Authentication settings for each in-scope system

controls.title: Least-privilege access provisioning
controls.description: Access is granted only with approval and only to what a role needs.
evidence: Approval for each access grant in the period

controls.title: Periodic access review
controls.description: At least quarterly, a reviewer confirms that each account on each in-scope system is still needed, and removes what is not.
evidence: User listing per system, the reviewer's decisions and sign-off

controls.title: Privileged access restricted
controls.description: Administrative access is limited to named people who need it, used only for administration, and reviewed at least quarterly.
evidence: List of privileged accounts and its review

controls.title: Credential and secret management
controls.description: Secrets and credentials are held in managed custody, never in source code, and are rotated on schedule and revoked when their holder leaves.
evidence: Record of each credential's issue, rotation and revocation

controls.title: Physical access to facilities
controls.description: Physical access to facilities that house system components is restricted to authorized people and reviewed.
evidence: Physical access list and its review

controls.title: Secure disposal
controls.description: Devices and data are disposed of so that information cannot be recovered, and disposal is recorded.
evidence: Disposal records

controls.title: Network boundary protection
controls.description: Inbound access to the system is restricted to the services that need to be reachable, and administrative interfaces are not exposed publicly.
evidence: Network or firewall configuration

controls.title: Encryption in transit and at rest
controls.description: Data is encrypted in transit over public networks and at rest in the system's data stores.
evidence: TLS and storage encryption configuration

controls.title: Endpoint protection
controls.description: Devices used to reach the system have disk encryption, screen lock, current updates and malware protection.
evidence: Device attestation or management report for each person

controls.title: Customer data access restricted
controls.description: Access to production customer data is limited to authorized people with a need, and is reviewed.
evidence: List of people with production data access and its review

controls.title: Logging, monitoring and alerting
controls.description: Security-relevant events are logged, retained and monitored, and alerts reach someone who responds.
evidence: Logging and alerting configuration
Example alerts and their handling

controls.title: Incident response plan tested
controls.description: An incident response plan names roles and steps, and is exercised at least once a year.
evidence: Current plan
Record of the annual exercise

controls.title: Incidents recorded and reviewed
controls.description: Each security incident is recorded, assessed, contained, resolved and reviewed afterwards, with notification where commitments require it.
evidence: Incident records with timeline and review

controls.title: Configuration managed and drift detected
controls.description: System configuration is defined in reviewed source or baselines, and changes made outside that process are detected.
evidence: Configuration source and drift reports

controls.title: Backups and restore tests
controls.description: Data needed to restore the service is backed up on schedule, and a restore is tested at least once a year.
evidence: Backup configuration
Record of the annual restore test

controls.title: Capacity and availability monitoring
controls.description: Capacity and availability are monitored against commitments, and shortfalls are acted on.
evidence: Availability monitoring and capacity reviews

controls.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery
controls.description: A continuity and recovery plan covers the loss of key systems, providers and people, and is tested at least once a year.
evidence: Current plan
Record of the annual test

controls.title: Independent change approval
controls.description: Each change to the production system is reviewed and approved by someone other than its author before it reaches production.
evidence: Population of production changes with their approvals

controls.title: Changes verified before release
controls.description: Each change is verified before release, and the verification performed is recorded with the change.
evidence: Verification record for each sampled change

controls.title: Controlled production deployment
controls.description: Only approved releases reach production, and only people or processes authorized to deploy can do so.
evidence: Deployment records with their approvals
List of who can deploy

controls.title: Emergency changes
controls.description: A change made outside the normal flow in an emergency is recorded and approved afterwards, or the organization records that no such path exists.
evidence: Emergency change records, or the recorded absence of the path

controls.title: Dependency and supply-chain management
controls.description: Third-party dependencies are pinned, their provenance is known, and they are scanned for known vulnerabilities.
evidence: Lockfiles and dependency scan results

controls.title: Vendor inventory
controls.description: Vendors that support the system are listed with the service they provide, the data they can reach and their criticality.
evidence: Vendor register

controls.title: Vendor due diligence
controls.description: Critical vendors are assessed before use and each year after, using their assurance reports where available.
evidence: Assessment record and assurance report for each critical vendor

controls.title: Vendor commitments
controls.description: Agreements with vendors that handle confidential or personal data include security and confidentiality commitments.
evidence: Agreements or terms for each such vendor

controls.title: Data classification and handling
controls.description: Information is classified, and each class has handling rules that personnel follow.
evidence: Classification scheme and data inventory

controls.title: Retention and deletion
controls.description: Confidential information is retained only as long as commitments and law require, then deleted, and deletion is recorded.
evidence: Retention schedule and deletion records

controls.title: Processing specifications
controls.description: The inputs, processing and outputs the service commits to are specified and communicated.
evidence: Processing specifications

controls.title: Input and processing validation
controls.description: Inputs are validated, processing errors are detected and corrected, and exceptions are tracked.
evidence: Validation design and error-handling records

controls.title: Output and storage integrity
controls.description: Outputs are complete, accurate and delivered on time, and stored inputs and outputs are protected from alteration.
evidence: Reconciliation or integrity checks and their results

controls.title: Privacy notice
controls.description: A privacy notice describes what personal information is collected, why, and how individuals exercise their rights.
evidence: Published privacy notice and its revision history

controls.title: Consent and choice
controls.description: Individuals are given the choices the notice promises, and consent is obtained and recorded where required.
evidence: Consent records

controls.title: Collection and use limited to purpose
controls.description: Personal information is collected and used only for the purposes in the notice.
evidence: Data inventory mapped to stated purposes

controls.title: Retention and disposal of personal information
controls.description: Personal information is kept only as long as needed for its purpose and then disposed of.
evidence: Retention schedule and disposal records

controls.title: Access and correction requests
controls.description: Requests from individuals to access or correct their information are recorded and answered within the committed time.
evidence: Request log with response times

controls.title: Disclosures and breach notification
controls.description: Disclosures of personal information to third parties are authorized and recorded, third parties are bound to protect it, and breaches are notified as required.
evidence: Disclosure records
Third-party agreements
Breach notification records

controls.title: Quality of personal information
controls.description: Personal information is kept accurate, complete and relevant for its purpose.
evidence: Data quality procedure and its results

controls.title: Privacy inquiries and complaints
controls.description: Privacy inquiries, complaints and disputes are recorded, addressed and monitored.
evidence: Inquiry and complaint log
